notes.content: Fixed bugs, collider and position of objects highlighted by our community in the official Bug Form.

notes.title: First minor update
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the player can occasionally get stuck in the toy plane in lv4
- Fixed an issue where the player can get stuck inside a couple of colliders in lv5
- Improved overall stability

notes.title: Online Bug Form
notes.content:
We have been working hard during these last couple of months polishing the game for you, our beloved players but something will definitely break 🥲

That's why you've also created a Bug Report form inside the game Main Menu you can use to submit the problems you'll encounter and help us fix them for you! Hopefully, you won't need it but we wanted to let you know we have your back!

Here's a public link to it too: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeA1tq8lOodDRlxWtpKiVAG88uBp6rISmM4kd3IWDx6GuTnvA/viewform]An Everyday Story Bug Form[/url]

notes.title: An Everyday Story Launch!
notes.content:
This is it: 
We are super, super excited ( and a little, little bit scared ) for the official release of our first game “An Everyday Story” on Steam! We poured our heart into this project during these last few years and hope you’ll enjoy it! 

Thank you all for the support and love you shared with us these last few years. We hope you'll enjoy An Everyday Story and have a great time with it!

Enjoy the Launch trailer:

notes.title: An Everyday Story Official Date Announcement
notes.content:
It's official: 
An Everyday Story will be available on #steam on the 25th of September. It's just a couple of weeks away, can you believe it? 😍

We are super excited ( and a little bit scared ) for what's to come and we hope you are too!
To celebrate the occasion we have updated our demo with all the latest improvements; hopefully, it will work just fine :D
Enjoy and see you soon!

notes.title: Presenting the Bat Origami
notes.content:
New week, new playable character introduction! This time we present the BAT ORIGAMI! This little fellow is the result of a teenager's hard work and dedication, all done to make his father proud...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281375/eaf4d2db2492492d0c3aa721ada9a7505cbd236d.png[/img]

Controlling the origami, the player can double jump, glide and thin himself to overcome some obstacles and discover secret areas. Out of the three, the origami is definitely the most acrobatic and graceful!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281375/a72bef21c6cedc1131501e2ff86b15cc7af7bbef.png[/img]

notes.title: Introducing the Tin Soldier
notes.content:
Hey all, since there are a lot of new faces who joined us these last months, we thought of making a quick introduction of the trinkets you'll be able to play with in An Everyday Story starting from the Tin Soldier! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281375/d83ac1147ef71000cf831b045677a3e8be75d024.png[/img]

His father gifted it to the protagonist when he was a little boy, and that's why he holds it so dear. Gameplay-wise, the Tin Soldier will be able to jump, shoot and even use a grappling hook to reach higher places and swing across empty spaces! 
He's sort of an old-fashioned "Indiana Jones kinda guy" if you will. 
Who knows, maybe he has other tricks up his sleeves...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281375/90a057b22cfad12fa0b0282981371e6f0dde0146.png[/img]

notes.title: Participation in the Games in Italy
notes.content:
Hey everyone, it's been a while since our latest announcement (yikes, Steam Fest was a long time ago) but We wanted to give you a quick update on the game. 

We are working hard on the game and development is proceeding smoothly as we approach the final phase of testing while heading toward the final release!

Today we wanted to announce that we are participating in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/40319802-Games-In-Italy/sale/gamesinitaly]Games in Italy[/url]] section with all our fellow Italian developers out there.

We know it's not much but rest assured we'll posting regularly from now on and feel free to follow us on socials to get the latest updates too!

notes.title: An Everyday Story Demo for Steam Fest 2023
notes.content:
